desc: Ideate middle-index decomposition and validity cases: a+b>=2 valid, a+b=1 requires pairwise-distinct non-middle values, a+b=0 invalid.
Implement brute-force oracle and O(n^2) Counter solution; examples and randomized small-array cross-checks pass.
Review edge cases: all equal, all distinct, n=5, negative/large values, boundary middles, frequency-2 ties, cross-side duplicate collisions, and modulo handling.
Confirm complexity is acceptable for n <= 1000; no further optimization needed.
